=== .github/workflows/ci.yml (hosted-workflows)
# Imported from .github/workflows/ci.yml by launchway import pipeline. The old files are untouched.
# Read the findings it printed: lines marked NEEDS A PERSON below are not converted.
pipeline: shop-ci
on:
  push: {branches: [main, release/*], tags: [v*], paths: [src/**, go.mod]}
  pull_request: {into: [main]}
  schedule:
    - {cron: 17 3 * * 1}
supersede: true
inputs:
  target: {type: choice, description: Where to run, options: [dev, test], default: dev}
  verbose: {type: boolean, default: false}
  region: {}
defaults:
  env: {GOFLAGS: -mod=readonly}
containers:
  integration: {image: 'golang:1.22'}
  integration-db:
    image: postgres:16
    service: true
    env: {POSTGRES_PASSWORD: '${DB_PASSWORD}'}
    ready: {tcp: 5432}
steps:
  unit:
    uses: launchway/go-test
    with: {go_version: "1.22"}
  matrix:
    image: {each: node, format: 'docker.io/library/node:%s'}
    needs: unit
    on_failure: continue
    for_each:
      node: ["18", "20"]
      os: [ubuntu-latest]
    exclude:
      - {node: "18", os: ubuntu-latest}
    add:
      - {node: "22", os: ubuntu-latest}
    max_parallel: 2
    fail_fast: false
    env:
      npm_config_cache: .cache/npm
    run: |
      # Install
      npm ci
      # Test
      (
        cd web
        export CI=true
        npm test -- --target ${LAUNCHWAY_INPUT_TARGET}
        echo "node ${LAUNCHWAY_EACH_NODE} on ${LAUNCHWAY_COMMIT}"
      )
    cache:
      - {name: npm, paths: [.cache/npm], key: {files: ['**/package-lock.json']}}
    artifacts:
      - {name: web-report, paths: [web/report, web/coverage.xml], retain: 7d}
  integration:
    container: integration
    needs: unit
    env:
      MODE: ci
      GOMODCACHE: .cache/go-mod
    secrets:
      DB_PASSWORD: {store: vault, key: DB_PASSWORD, field: value}
    run: |
      (
        export DATABASE_URL=postgres://postgres@db:5432/postgres
        go test -tags integration ./...
      )
    cache:
      - {name: cache-go-mod, paths: [.cache/go-mod], key: {files: ['**/go.sum'], text: go}}
  report:
    image: docker.io/library/ubuntu:24.04
    needs: [matrix, integration]
    when: {upstream: always}
    run: |
      ls out
    fetch:
      - {from: matrix, name: web-report, into: out}
  site:
    image: docker.io/library/ubuntu:24.04
    needs: unit
    when: {branch: main, event: push}
    run: |
      echo build the site
  tagged:
    image: docker.io/library/ubuntu:24.04
    needs: unit
    when: {tag: v*}
    run: |
      echo tagged

--- findings
